name: Sofa Drip - 3 Seater Sofa (Fabric, Pine Green)
description: The Drip Sofa is sleek, stylish, and effortlessly comfortable. Designed with a clean, modern vibe, the Drip Sofa is here to instantly level up your living space. Upholstered in premium performance-woven fabric and built on a sturdy solid wood frame, it’s made for real everyday living; stylish and durable. The elevated legs give it that light, airy look while making under-sofa cleaning super easy (because nobody likes dust!). Crafted with 317 GSM performance fabric engineered to withstand over 50,000 rub cycles, this sofa doesn’t just look good, it’s designed to give you main character vibes. For the comfort crowd, the Drip Sofa totally delivers. The deep seats, plush removable back cushions, and supportive high-density foam, lets you sink in and switch off after a long day. The floating-arm design adds a sleek, statement look while still keeping things cozy and inviting. Available in 1, 2, and 3-seater variants, the Drip Sofa adapts seamlessly to homes of every size. Whether you’re entertaining guests, lounging with your pet, or creating a stylish nook in your home office, the Drip Sofa blends, it blends comfort and style effortlessly. Choose from two snatched shades: a warm Sandstone Beige or the rich, statement-making Pine Green, to complement your decor effortlessly. Backed by a 3-year conditional warranty, the Drip Sofa is a perfect mix of comfort, function, and timeless modern design.

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs 1. What is Sofa Drip? Sleepyhead Sofa Drip is a modern fabric sofa designed to bring style and comfort to your living space. Featuring a distinctive floating-arm design, deep seating, and plush removable back cushions, it combines contemporary aesthetics with everyday comfort. 2. What are its unique features? Sofa Drip features a striking floating-arm design, elevated wooden-finish legs, and removable back cushions for customised comfort. Its 317 GSM performance-woven fabric is tested to withstand over 50,000 rub cycles, while the high-density foam seating offers supportive comfort. 3. Is professional installation/assembly included with Sofa Drip? No, the sofa assembly is DIY (Do It Yourself). 4. What are the space requirements for Sofa Drip? The 3-seater Sofa Drip measures 178 cm (70.7 inches) in width, 90 cm (35.4 inches) in depth, and 85.5 cm (33.7 inches) in height. Ensure your living room has enough space for the sofa and comfortable movement around it. 5. What warranty comes with Sofa Drip? Sofa Drip comes with a 3‑year conditional warranty. 6. Can I try the Sofa Drip before purchasing? Yes, you can try this sofa at your nearest Sleepyhead store. 7. Is the Sofa Drip customizable (fabric, color, configuration)? Sofa Drip is offered in multiple colours (Pine green and Sandstone Beige) and in 1-seater, 2‑seater, and 3‑seater sizes. But currently we do not offer other customisation options. 8. What seating configurations are available for Sofa Drip? Sofa Drip is available as a 1-seater, 2‑seater, and 3‑seater standalone sofa. 9. How do I clean and maintain Sofa Drip? Clean using a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth for dust and light spills; for stains, blot (do not rub) with a mild, non‑bleach detergent solution on a damp cloth, then wipe with a clean, dry cloth. You should avoid harsh chemicals, sharp objects, and prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the sofa’s colour and comfort.
